items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We did, and we recorded a fantastic song together that I partially wrote, called Sunrise.

ctx.x: I figured that would be the case.
We did, and we recorded a fantastic song together that I partially wrote, called Sunrise. You got to hear that song. Have you heard that, Sunrise? [Unidentified]: No, I haven’t.
You got to hear the song called Sunrise. We recorded it in Chet Atkins’s studio. Anyway, we were talking about what?
